svg.text: What happens next / 之后会怎样

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: • Failed items are shown as warnings on the card — never silently dropped.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: 核不过的证据显示在卡片上，不会被悄悄丢掉。

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: • Business rules then reject contradictions, e.g. confidence “high” while hypotheses are unresolved.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: 业务规则再拒绝矛盾，例如置信度写 high、清单里却还有没排除的方向。

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: • A fully verbatim conclusion can still be wrong: verification catches fake quotes, not bad reasoning.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: 全部逐字的结论也可能是错的：校验抓的是编造的引用，不是错误的推理。

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif
